desc: Read N and the permutation P.
Compute the position array `pos` where `pos[P[i]] = i` (using 1-based indexing).
Compute the minimum cost by iterating through each element $x$ from $1$ to $N$: if $pos[x] > x$, add $(pos[x] - x) \times x$; if $pos[x] < x$, add $(x - pos[x]) \times (N - x + 1)$. Print the result.
